user.title: Room Control Profiles
user.description: Create a central, read-only room profile sensor. Add individual rooms under Configure after setup.

climate.title: Climate and room entities
climate.description: Optional. Leave empty for safe Area-based climate discovery. No devices are changed.

cleaning.title: Cleaning and shared robot bindings
cleaning.description: Select only entities you have verified. Empty fields leave resolution to the card; this screen does not command the robot.

robot_map.title: Robot map reference (optional)
robot_map.description: Metadata only. A nonzero segment ID requires explicit robot and map, plus manual confirmation. This does not control the robot.

review.title: Save profile for {room}?
review.description: This updates the shared sensor. It does not operate devices, reset queues or send notifications.

error.unknown_area: Select an existing Home Assistant Area
error.invalid_profile: One or more profile fields are invalid
